selected_evidence.requirement: Application data is stored on persistent snapshot-capable storage under `/srv/data`.
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the XFS logical volume mounted at `/srv/data`, persistent systemd/fstab configuration, and successful storage detach/reattach testing.

selected_evidence.requirement: An earlier filesystem-consistent snapshot was captured before modification.
selected_evidence.summary: Records the original content and metadata manifest, followed by creation of the quiesced `data_before_change` LVM snapshot.

selected_evidence.requirement: The directory was materially modified after the snapshot.
selected_evidence.summary: Shows changed application content and permissions, a deleted file, a newly added path, differing manifest hash, and snapshot COW usage.

selected_evidence.requirement: The exact content captured by the earlier snapshot was restored.
selected_evidence.summary: Shows snapshot merge and remount, then identical baseline/restored manifest hashes and `EXACT_RESTORE=PASS` across content, tree structure, ownership, modes, sizes, timestamps, symlinks, and checksums.

selected_evidence.requirement: Application data remains recoverable through a retained snapshot.
selected_evidence.summary: Shows retained snapshot `data_recovered` and successful post-reboot read-only snapshot validation against the exact baseline manifest.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence.
selected_evidence.summary: Captures healthy pre-restart service/data state and boot ID, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered mount/service/LVM state, exact live-data match, no failed units, and readable retained snapshot after restart.
